findings.title: Forward Target Lookahead in Market Breadth
findings.impact: Inflated Phase 2 Net Profit Factor from 2.000 to 2.605 in Dev, and 1.454 to 1.592 in Val.
findings.action_required: Formally invalidate August 19 locked specification; mandate Ret_1D_Trailing.

findings.title: Forward Benchmark Accumulation Leakage
findings.impact: Leaked future returns into benchmark moving averages and all regime indicators.
findings.action_required: Enforce trailing returns for all benchmark index calculations.

findings.title: Prior 2026 Holdout Exposure Before Lock
findings.impact: Winning candidate was selected post-hoc after observing PF = 3.084 in 2026.
findings.action_required: Acknowledge 2026 as contaminated holdout; reserve Q4 2026/2027 as true blind holdout.

findings.title: Synthetic Random Backtest in Production Engine
findings.impact: Production edge certification is based on synthetic Gaussian noise with seed 42.
findings.action_required: Replace random simulation with real vectorized backtesting over historical bars.

findings.title: Hardcoded Plateau Stability Validator
findings.impact: Unit tests pass fraudulently against static dictionary; fails to detect real parameter spikes.
findings.action_required: Implement true empirical parametric sweep across lookback neighborhood.

findings.title: Nominal Share Price Used as Fundamental Alpha
findings.impact: Biases factor optimization arbitrarily toward nominal high-priced equities.
findings.action_required: Replace nominal price with price-invariant valuation ratios or standardized factors.

findings.title: Synthetic Nominal Reference in Market Breadth
findings.impact: Classifies any stock under 50 EGP as 'deep crash' regardless of percentage return.
findings.action_required: Compute breadth from percentage price changes relative to previous day close.

findings.title: Gross vs Net Profit Factor Hurdle Inconsistency
findings.code_fragment: gw = gross[gross > 0].sum(); gl = abs(gross[gross < 0].sum()); pf = gw / (gl + 1e-9)
findings.impact: Reported Gross PF (2.138) as Net PF after 0.90% cost; True Net PF is 1.821 (+0.317 bias).
findings.action_required: Explicitly report both Gross PF and True Net PF across all documentation.

findings.title: Sequential Trade Compounding Drawdown Artifact
findings.impact: Geometrically compounded overlapping trades, producing fake -100% drawdown.
findings.action_required: Enforce daily calendar-time Mark-to-Market portfolio accounting.

findings.title: Severe Zero-Volume Illiquidity in ORAS.CA
findings.impact: Dynamic slippage models and market-order fill assumptions break down.
findings.action_required: Flag ORAS.CA as illiquid block-only; apply fixed 50 bps slippage cap.

findings.title: Debunked Survivorship Bias Resolution Claim
findings.code_fragment: Claimed 8 delisted stocks resolved survivorship bias; all 8 are active survivors.
findings.impact: Historical backtests carry uncorrected upward survivorship selection bias.
findings.action_required: Formally mandate permanent caveat: SURVIVORSHIP_BIAS_UNRESOLVED.

findings.title: Disjoint Offset Masking via Full Sample Pooling
findings.code_fragment: Claimed 100% of offsets passed hurdle; on 2025 alone, median Net PF is only 1.591.
findings.impact: 75% of disjoint execution offsets fail the baseline bar on the clean validation period.
findings.action_required: Report disjoint performance on isolated out-of-sample periods separately.

findings.title: Decoupling of Research Pipeline from Main Runtime
findings.code_fragment: Commit 31fe1a4 purged research engines and parquets from main.
findings.impact: Impossible to run quantitative research regression tests directly on main.
findings.action_required: Integrate isolated clean-room research harness into main repository.

findings.title: Production SQLite Historical Bar Starvation
findings.code_fragment: Contains 8,199 rows spanning July 12, 2026 to September 10, 2026 only.
findings.impact: 200-day moving averages and multi-year lookbacks fail, triggering synthetic fallbacks.
findings.action_required: Hydrate table with full 5-year historical clean bars (2020-2026).

findings.title: Overnight Entry Gap Discrepancy
findings.impact: Introduces mean tracking error of -0.0033% and single-stock variance of +/-8.69%.
findings.action_required: Implement dual-target tracking: Target A (Close-to-Close) and Target B (Open-to-Close).

findings.title: Sharpe Ratio Annualization Scaling Distortion
findings.impact: Violates independence assumptions due to 19-day moving average autocorrelation.
findings.action_required: Adopt daily portfolio net equity Sharpe as primary institutional metric.

findings.title: Inverted Sample Size in Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR)
findings.code_fragment: years = T / 252.0 if T >= 252 else T; variance_sr = (...) / max(1.0, years)
findings.impact: Inflates Sharpe variance estimator by 252x, suppressing z-statistic by 15.87x.
findings.action_required: Divide variance by total observation count T matching Bailey & Lopez de Prado.

findings.title: Truncation of Ezz Steel Rebar (ESRS.CA)
findings.impact: Reduces cross-sectional breadth denominator from 27 to 26 after March 2025.
findings.action_required: Normalize cross-sectional breadth denominators to count only active reporting constituents.

findings.title: Yahoo Finance Auction Cross-Price Boundary Jumps
findings.code_fragment: 264 sessions where Close falls outside [Low, High].
findings.impact: Triggers false positives in naive OHLC data quality checks.
findings.action_required: Permit auction clearing variance in exchange data quality checks.

findings.title: Unused/Dead Research Sandbox (research_v5/)
findings.code_fragment: Contains 1 incomplete script downloading only 10 equities.
findings.impact: Creates ambiguity regarding authoritative research location.
findings.action_required: Maintain clear demarcation between research_v5 sandbox and authoritative research.

findings.title: Full-Dataset Normalization Leakage (BUG-03)
findings.code_fragment: RobustScaler fitted across full dataset before fold split.
findings.impact: Leaked future test distribution parameters into training folds.
findings.action_required: Maintain fold-local scaler fitting in all feature engineering.

findings.title: Duplicate Accounting Disclosures Collision (BUG-02)
findings.code_fragment: Crashed when multiple filings shared the same accounting period end date.
findings.impact: Data ingestion crash during point-in-time fundamentals alignment.
findings.action_required: Retain deduplication logic in PIT fundamentals pipeline.

findings.title: Stock Split Data Quality Penalty (BUG-01)
findings.code_fragment: Unadjusted price jumps from 2:1 or 10:1 splits penalized DQ scores.
findings.impact: Misclassified genuine corporate actions as data corruption.
findings.action_required: Maintain split adjustment logic in data cleaning foundation.

findings.title: Production Core Protected and Frozen Invariants Preserved
findings.code_fragment: Cash Gate >= 10%, Allocation Cap <= 65%, Max Position Size <= 10%
findings.impact: Production risk firewalls and broker safety mechanisms remain 100% active and uncompromised.
findings.action_required: Keep production safety perimeter 100% frozen and protected.

findings.title: Dual-Currency GDR Dimensional Unit Mismatch (EKHO.CA)
findings.impact: Produced an economically absurd spread of +6501.49% for EKHO.CA by subtracting USD quote (0.67$) from EGP implied price (44.27 EGP).
findings.action_required: Enforce cairo_currency recognition and compute spread in matching currency (USD vs USD or EGP vs EGP).
